summary: Verified fresh import of BDS Marvel runs end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering health (/api/), auth (register sets JWT cookie, admin login returns role=admin, /auth/me 401 when unauthenticated), inquiries (public POST 201, GET 401 unauth / 200 admin), stays (availability returns {booked, requested}, authed instant booking returns 201 with BDS- reference, overlap returns 409, unauth 401), and admin dashboard (/admin/overview, /admin/bookings, /admin/enquiries return correct shape with admin cookies, 401 without). Frontend: homepage shows 'Architecture. Interiors. Everything In Between.' brand intro; /stays renders Premium/Mid/Budget-friendly tier sections with listings; /owner login with admin@bdsmarvel.com / <redacted> succeeds and shows owner-dashboard with all 4 stats tiles and 3 tabs (Night requests / All bookings / Enquiries) switchable. Email send endpoint accepts submissions (previously confirmed HTTP 202).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1079 lines; consider splitting routers (auth, stays, admin, catalog) into modules for maintainability (pre-existing, flagged in prior iterations).
Backend lowercases emails on registration; this is correct, but FE/tests should compare case-insensitively.
Startup correctly re-seeds admin from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD and demotes other admins. Idempotent.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@bdsmarvel.com / <redacted>. Guests registered on the fly via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST inquiry and 1 TEST stay booking (The Living Studio, 45-47 days out). Cleaned up via pymongo at session end (bookings cancelled via admin API + inquiries/bookings prefixed TEST_ deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Import is clean. Admin creds are admin@bdsmarvel.com / <redacted> (NOT the legacy info.bdsmarvel@gmail.com used in older owner_dashboard_test.py). Fresh guest registration works. Stays availability returns a dict {booked: [...], requested: [...]}, not a flat list — unlike the older test_stays_backend.py which asserts a list (that older test is stale against this backend's /stays/availability). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_import_bdsm.py for regression.
